text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 12 · 蓝沙上的沉船花园.
Environment:  A beautiful empty underwater garden growing around the weathered hull of an old small wooden sailing ship, bleached warm wood ribs, pale sand walkway, sea grasses and branching limestone mineral forms, shafts of diffuse daylight from the surface. The ship is a peaceful ruin, no bones, treasure skeletons, fish, divers or creatures. Dreamy pale turquoise palette, clear midground.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 3 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit this contact sheet. Remove panel D entirely because it incorrectly mirrors the room. Retain original panels A, B and C exactly with their existing scene geometry, furniture, materials and light. Re-layout ONLY these three existing views as three equally sized panels side by side, labeled A, B, C. Preserve wide view content within each panel without cropping away key architecture; landscape overall. Do not invent new objects or views. Empty environment, no people. Return one three-panel image.
